title: Generic finite first-order countermodel construction and independent verification
independentExamples: A unary quantified argument whose conclusion adds an unsupported predicate
A binary relation argument whose converse is not entailed
Development-visible formal arguments with unrelated predicate signatures and constant assignments
outputTypes: total finite interpretation for every declared constant and predicate
invariants: search branches only on logical structure and typed symbols
every returned interpretation satisfies every premise and falsifies the conclusion
SAT output is replayed by an independent first-order evaluator
failure to find a model in one domain is not promoted to unrestricted validity
uncertaintySemantics: RESOURCE_LIMIT and NO_COUNTERMODEL_IN_DECLARED_DOMAIN are explicit and neither means globally valid.
proofBehavior: The constructor grounds quantified formulas for each bounded constant assignment, requests a DPLL countermodel, decodes a total interpretation, and accepts it only after independent first-order evaluation.

resourceBounds.BooleanSearch: inherits explicit scalable Boolean entailment semantic-atom, variable, clause, and search-node bounds

kbMigration: No KB schema or package changes. The method consumes typed formulas and does not reinterpret stored facts or rules.
freshPolicy: The 300-member LogicSkills fresh partition remains unopened until symbolization and validity candidates are also frozen or a separately declared countermodel-only fresh claim is approved.
